slides.title: Whole beans or ground coffee?
slides.subtitle: One choice decides how fast your coffee fades.

slides.title: Grinding changes everything
slides.body: Grinding breaks each bean into many tiny pieces. Far more surface meets the air, and oxygen is what stales coffee fastest.

slides.title: Your brewer picks the grind
slides.body: A moka pot and an espresso machine want different grinds. With whole beans, you choose. With a bag of ground coffee, someone else already did.

slides.label: The tip
slides.body: Stuck with ground coffee? Buy small bags, close them tight after each use, and finish them soon.

slides.title: Beans keep longer, ground saves time
slides.body: Whole beans protect the flavor. Ground coffee is convenient but fades sooner.
